features.heading: Core capabilities
features.col1Body: Freeze discussion conclusions into decision records with version history and bidirectional links to tasks — no more manual copying.
features.col2Body: Board/list views with drag-to-change-status and optimistic updates. Cmd+K global search across tasks and decisions.
features.col3Body: PostgreSQL row-level security (RLS) enforces multi-tenant isolation. Cross-workspace requests are blocked.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.q0: Is the free plan really free forever?
faq.a0: Yes. Workspaces with 10 or fewer members are free forever, including task boards, comments, three-tier roles, and Cmd+K search, with no time limit. The only soft limit is that decision records keep the most recent 10 per workspace.
faq.q1: What happens when my team exceeds 10 members?
faq.a1: When the 11th member accepts an invitation, the system prompts you to upgrade. Upgrading to Pro (¥59/seat/month, or ¥590/seat/year annually) removes the limit. You can also remove or deactivate members to free up seats and stay on the free tier — we never lock your data to force a paid plan.
faq.q2: What payment methods are supported? Can I get an invoice?
faq.a2: We support Alipay, WeChat Pay, and international cards. At this stage we provide electronic receipts; VAT invoice capability will be available once the domestic entity is ready (expected around general availability). If you need an invoice before purchasing, please contact the support email first.
faq.q3: Will I lose my data if I downgrade or cancel?
faq.a3: No. After cancellation, the workspace falls back to the free tier. Any excess (such as decision records beyond 10) is preserved as read-only and can be exported at any time. We never delete data.
faq.q4: How does seat-based billing work? Will adding members mid-cycle overcharge me?
faq.a4: Billing is based on purchased seats, and seat count syncs automatically as members join or leave. New seats added mid-month are prorated for the remaining days — you never pay an extra full month.
faq.q5: Can I cancel anytime? What's the refund policy?
faq.a5: You can cancel anytime from account settings, and access remains until the end of the current billing cycle. Monthly plans do not offer prorated refunds within the cycle; annual plans are eligible for a full refund within 14 days of purchase if no material usage has occurred.
